goals: Verify the correct server-side rendering and subsequent client-side rehydration of asynchronous React components, ensuring consistent output and state transfer.
activities: Save the global window object.
Delete the global window object to simulate a server environment.
Create a server-side async context.
Create the application for server rendering.
Asynchronously bootstrap the server application.
Render the server application to static HTML markup.
Expect the server HTML to match a snapshot.
Get the rehydration state from the server context.
Expect the rehydration state to match a snapshot.
Restore the global window object.
Create a client-side async context.
Create the application for client rendering with rehydration state.
Asynchronously bootstrap the client application.
Mount the client application using Enzyme.
Expect the client application wrapper to match a snapshot.
Save the global window object again.
Delete the global window object again.
Render the client application to static HTML markup.
Expect the client static HTML to be identical to the server HTML.
Restore the global window object.
Wait for 100 milliseconds.
Update the client application wrapper.
Expect the updated client application wrapper to match a snapshot.
Define an async component that throws an error during resolution.
Create an async component provider with the erroring component.
Asynchronously bootstrap the application.
Mount the application using Enzyme.
Wait for 1 millisecond.
Expect the rendered HTML to contain the error message.
Initialize a resolution counter to zero.
Define an async component that increments the counter upon resolution.
Create an async component provider with this component.
Asynchronously bootstrap the application.
Mount the application using Enzyme.
Expect the resolution counter to be 1.
Mount the application again using Enzyme.
Expect the resolution counter to still be 1.
Define an async component that resolves after a 100ms delay.
Create an async component provider with this component.
Asynchronously bootstrap the application.
Mount the application using Enzyme.
Expect the rendered HTML to contain 'Loading...'.
Define an async component that rejects its promise during resolution.
Create an async context.
Create an async component provider with the erroring component.
Asynchronously bootstrap the application.
Render the application to static HTML markup.
Expect the static HTML to contain the error message.
